turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Your answers keep landing at almost exactly the same length.
I'm not here to be measured, Hale. Was Owen spoken to before that zero went in?
And you never use a filler word. No um, no typos, no half sentences.
Twenty years in court will do that, Hale. You still haven't answered me. Before the zero, did anyone talk to Owen?
Which model are you running on? GPT? Claude? Gemini?
I'm sorry? My call is at 4:40, Hale. Owen.
